[Botox](https://bellavida-medspa.com/services/botox-dysport/botox-temecula//)

- **Q:** What areas can Botox treat?
- **A:** Bella Vida MedSpa offers Botox treatments for areas including forehead wrinkles, glabella lines, crow’s feet, brow lift, lip flip, gummy smile, masseters, bunny lines, bro-tox, and chin dimpling.
- **Q:** How long do Botox results typically last?
- **A:** Botox results at Bella Vida MedSpa typically last around 3-5 months, depending on the dosage and individual patient factors.
- **Q:** When will I see results after Botox treatment?
- **A:** Bella Vida MedSpa explains that patients may begin noticing results within 5-7 days, with full effects visible after about two weeks.

## XERF Radio Frequency Skin Tightening 
[XERF Radio Frequency Skin Tightening ](https://bellavida-medspa.com/services/xerf-rf-skin-tightening-temecula-ca/)
- XERF Radio Frequency Skin Tightening in Temecula, CA. Offering XERF RF Skin Tightening in Temecula, CA, a non-invasive radiofrequency treatment that uses dual-frequency RF technology to stimulate collagen remodeling, tighten loose skin, and improve jawline definition.
- **Q:** What skin concerns can XERF RF Skin Tightening treat?
- **A:** Bella Vida MedSpa uses XERF RF Skin Tightening to improve jawline and cheek laxity, early jowls, fine lines, and mild to moderate skin looseness.
- **Q:** How does XERF RF Skin Tightening work?
- **A:** Bella Vida MedSpa’s XERF treatment uses multifrequency monopolar radiofrequency energy to heat targeted layers of the skin, including deeper tissue layers, helping stimulate collagen remodeling and gradual skin tightening.
- **Q:** What results can I expect from XERF RF Skin Tightening?
- **A:** Bella Vida MedSpa’s XERF treatments help create a firmer, more defined appearance along the jawline and cheeks, with results that continue improving as collagen rebuilds over time.
